description: Source code for the HttpNetworkSession class in Chromium, managing HTTP/HTTPS network sessions, including configuration, connection pooling, and protocol support.

classes.name: HttpNetworkSession
classes.description: Manages HTTP/HTTPS network sessions, including configuration, connection pooling, protocol support, and session lifecycle.

classes.name: HttpNetworkSessionContext
classes.description: Provides context and dependencies for HttpNetworkSession, such as socket factories, resolvers, and services.

methods.name: StartResponseDrainer
methods.description: Starts draining an HTTP response body.

methods.name: RemoveResponseDrainer
methods.description: Removes a response drainer.

methods.name: GetSocketPool
methods.description: Retrieves the socket pool for a given type and proxy.

methods.name: SocketPoolInfoToValue
methods.description: Returns information about socket pools as a value.

methods.name: SpdySessionPoolInfoToValue
methods.description: Returns SPDY session pool info as a value.

methods.name: QuicInfoToValue
methods.description: Returns QUIC connection info as a value.

methods.name: CloseAllConnections
methods.description: Closes all active network connections with a specified error.

methods.name: CloseIdleConnections
methods.description: Closes idle network connections.

methods.name: SetServerPushDelegate
methods.description: Sets the server push delegate.

methods.name: IsQuicEnabled
methods.description: Checks if QUIC is enabled.

methods.name: DisableQuic
methods.description: Disables QUIC.

methods.name: SetEnableQuic
methods.description: Enables or disables QUIC (Cobalt customization).

methods.name: SetEnableHttp2
methods.description: Enables or disables HTTP/2 (Cobalt customization).

methods.name: UseQuicForUnknownOrigin
methods.description: Checks if QUIC is used for unknown origins (Cobalt customization).

methods.name: ClearSSLSessionCache
methods.description: Clears the SSL session cache.

methods.name: CreateCommonConnectJobParams
methods.description: Creates parameters for connection jobs.

methods.name: SetConnectionOptions
methods.description: Sets connection options for QUIC (Cobalt customization).

methods.name: SetClientConnectionOptions
methods.description: Sets client connection options for QUIC (Cobalt customization).

methods.name: GetSocketPoolManager
methods.description: Retrieves the socket pool manager for a given type.

methods.name: OnMemoryPressure
methods.description: Handles system memory pressure events.
